topics.topic_title: Geographical factors in Sri Lankan history

Describe pre-historic eras and early Aryan settlements
Explain establishment of Buddhism and socio-cultural change

learning_outcomes: Examine agriculture, irrigation, trade and culture
Describe successor kingdoms and foreign relations
Outline colonial transformation through 1978 executive presidency
